name: Lentil (Masoor)
soil_benefit: Legume that can contribute biologically fixed nitrogen and support soil fertility.
climate_resilience: High drought tolerance once established; low water footprint.
yield_potential: Moderate yield potential; fertilizer needs depend on soil conditions and management.

name: Mustard / Rapeseed
soil_benefit: Biofumigation may help suppress some soil-borne pests and pathogens under suitable management.
climate_resilience: Moderate water stress tolerance; rotation may help interrupt some weed and disease cycles.
yield_potential: High cash-crop potential; growth duration and market value vary by cultivar and local conditions.

name: Wheat
soil_benefit: Dense fibrous roots can support soil structure and aeration.
climate_resilience: Can be sensitive to heat stress during grain filling.
yield_potential: High caloric and market grain yield under balanced moisture.

name: Maize (Corn)
soil_benefit: Generates substantial organic biomass residues when tilled into soil.
climate_resilience: Moderate drought tolerance, but vulnerable to drought during silking.
yield_potential: Very high biomass and commercial grain yield potential.

name: Chickpea (Gram)
soil_benefit: Legume that can contribute biologically fixed nitrogen; has a deep taproot system.
climate_resilience: Can tolerate drought once established; susceptible to waterlogging.
yield_potential: High nutritional value; yield and market returns depend on local conditions.

name: Mung Bean (Green Gram)
soil_benefit: Short-season legume that can contribute biologically fixed nitrogen and provide soil cover.
yield_potential: Short-season crop with potential cash returns that vary by local conditions and markets.

name: Groundnut (Peanut)
soil_benefit: Canopy cover may help reduce soil erosion; this legume can contribute biologically fixed nitrogen.
yield_potential: High-value edible oil and protein crop.

name: Rice (Boro / Summer)
soil_benefit: Flooded growing conditions may suppress some terrestrial soil weeds.
climate_resilience: Low drought tolerance; requires regular water.
